newsitem.title: USA: Ascent Entertainment chairman steps down.
newsitem.headline: Ascent Entertainment chairman steps down.

text.p: Ascent Entertainment Group Inc said on Wednesday its chairman C.J. Silas has resigned from the board, effective April 29.
Silas also resigned as chairman of Comsat Corp, Comsat had said earlier today.
Silas underwent open heart surgery three weeks ago and is recovering at his home in Oklahoma, Ascent said.
No immediate successor was named, but Ascent expects to take such action in time for its May 13 annual meeting of stockholders.
Ascent Entertainment is 81 percent owned by Comsat, which plans to sell the investment sometime this year.
